reasons.action: The brief asks for a performed behavior — two mechanics arguing, with an English spoken line, 'That belt is done.' That explicit requested action/performance governs the action attribute; with no reference supplied there is nothing else to inherit it from.
reasons.medium: The medium owner is pinned by the schema and no reference or style phrase exists, so the request alone governs rendering medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference is supplied, so there are no observed clothes to retain; the request governs wardrobe for the two mechanics.
reasons.lighting: No reference image or clip provides observed lighting, and the brief names no lighting source, direction or quality; therefore the request governs lighting.
reasons.framing: No reference supplies an observed composition, shot scale or viewpoint, so the requested framing governs; the 16:9 target is only canvas metadata and does not itself specify camera composition.
reasons.palette: No reference provides an observed color grade or tonal treatment, and no explicit grade is requested; the request therefore governs palette.
